147.news_title: 26inch LCD 4:3 Ratio with Low Monitor Lag now on Sale
147.long_description: Our Arcooda 26inch LCD 4:3 Ratio with low monitor lag is on sale through our pre-order system. The 26" arcade LCD panel offers a 4:3 viewing ratio with RGB, VGA and HDMI inputs and supports 15khz 24khz 31khz, and high definition up to 1600 x 1200 UXGA resolution. Low response time, great colour depth the custom arcade monitor firmware. Our low monitor lag monitor is perfect for use in your arcade cabinets with angle mounting options, or, add a desktop stand and use the VESA monitor mount to use for your home retro gaming. Monitor Lag testing was performed using the Leo Bodnar Lag Tester. To order our 26inch 4:3 arcade monitor, please follow this link.
